tasks.label: 3DS: Build CIA (Docker)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/project" -w /project/3ds devkitpro/devkitarm:latest bash -c 'source /etc/profile.d/devkit-env.sh && make cia'
tasks.detail: Compile le projet 3DS en .cia en utilisant l'image Docker de devkitPro.

tasks.label: 3DS: Clean Build (Docker)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/project" -w /project/3ds devkitpro/devkitarm:latest bash -c 'source /etc/profile.d/devkit-env.sh && make clean'
tasks.detail: Nettoie les fichiers de build du projet 3DS.
